name: malam-ishaku-suya-site
description: Static site for Malam Ishaku Suya. No build step is required to serve or deploy the site — css/style.min.css and js/script.min.js are committed, production-ready builds. Run `npm run minify` locally after editing css/style.css or js/script.js to regenerate them (this script is deliberately not named "build" so Vercel never auto-runs it).

scripts.minify: npm run minify:css && npm run minify:js
scripts.minify:js: terser js/script.js -o js/script.min.js -c -m && terser js/conversion-tracking.js -o js/conversion-tracking.min.js -c -m
